in_sanskrit.name: Kamadhenu
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The divine cow, who is the embodiment of all desires, fulfilling the desires of her devotees.

in_marathi.name: Kamaraj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Love
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kamaraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Kama is the Hindu god of desire, love, and pleasure. Raj means king or ruler. Kamaraj is the lord of love and ruler of our desires.

in_bengali.name: Kamaraj
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of Love
in_bengali.long_meaning: Kamaraj একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Kama is the Hindu god of desire, love, and pleasure. Raj means king or ruler. Kamaraj is the lord of love and ruler of our desires.
